intro.title: Simple Websites That Load Fast and Just Work
paragraphs: A static website is made of fixed web pages built with HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript. Every visitor sees the same pages, delivered straight from the server or a global CDN, with no database or complex software running in the background. That makes static sites extremely fast, secure, reliable and inexpensive to run.

For many businesses that is exactly what they need: a professional online presence that explains who you are, what you offer and how to contact you. Our static web designing services cover layout design, responsive HTML and CSS development, on-page SEO, contact forms, WhatsApp and Google Maps, plus domain, hosting and SSL setup, so your site is ready to go live.

Need regular updates, logins, a blog or an online store instead? A <dynamic>dynamic website</dynamic> may suit you better, and a static site can be upgraded later. Compare options on our <wd>web design services</wd> page or <contact>ask us what fits your business</contact>.
highlights: Highly secure: no database to attack

faqs.title: Static Website FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about static website design.

items.a: A static website is made of fixed HTML pages that show the same content to every visitor, without a database. It is fast, secure and inexpensive, and ideal for business, portfolio and landing page websites.

items.q: What is the difference between a static and a dynamic website?
items.a: A static website serves fixed pages and is changed by editing the files. A dynamic website generates pages from a database and an admin panel, which suits blogs, logins, bookings and online stores but costs more to build and maintain.

items.q: How much does it cost to build a static website?
items.a: A one-page static website typically costs $200 to $500, a business static website of up to 8 pages $500 to $1,200, and larger static sites $1,200 to $2,500, depending on design and features.

items.q: How long does it take to design a static website?
items.a: A one-page site takes 3 to 5 days, and most business static websites go live in 1 to 2 weeks once content is ready.

items.q: Are static websites good for SEO?
items.a: Yes. Static websites load very fast and have clean code, which helps Core Web Vitals and rankings. With good content, meta tags, schema and a sitemap, a static site can rank very well.

items.q: Can I update my static website or upgrade it later?
items.a: Yes. We can make small updates for you, add a simple content editor, or upgrade your static website to a dynamic site with a CMS, blog or store whenever you need.
